sections.title: Day 41 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握差旅報銷、會議與費用上限的商務單字
- 辨認關係子句、分詞修飾、比較級與未來時間子句

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜關係代名詞與分詞修飾、比較級與 as...as、未來時間子句、介系詞與連接詞、主詞一致與固定搭配
sections.markdown:
主題：**關係代名詞與分詞修飾、比較級與 as...as、未來時間子句、介系詞與連接詞、主詞一致與固定搭配**

### 規則 1

**關係代名詞與分詞修飾**

指人的主詞關係代名詞使用 who；名詞承受動作時可用過去分詞修飾。

> The forms submitted yesterday will be reviewed.

### 規則 2

**比較級與 as...as**

有 than 用比較級；as...as 中間用原級。

> The meeting ended earlier than expected.

### 規則 3

**未來時間子句**

as soon as / once / when 引導未來時間子句，通常用現在式。

> We will email you once payment arrives.

### 規則 4

**介系詞與連接詞**

Although 後接完整子句；despite/due to 後接名詞或名詞片語。

> Although the fare rose, the company kept the budget.

### 規則 5

**主詞一致與固定搭配**

neither...nor 採就近一致；responsible for + V-ing。

> Neither the manager nor the assistants were available.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Product Demonstration and Tentative Schedule
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: I saw that the product demonstration was moved from ten to eleven thirty. Is the client still arriving at ten? Woman: Yes, but their engineer's flight has been delayed. We can start with a showroom tour at ten and begin the live demonstration at eleven thirty. Man: Should I send the revised agenda now? Woman: Wait until the engineer confirms the arrival time. So far, we've only received an airline update. Meanwhile, could you extend our testing-room reservation from noon until one?

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Venue Selection with a Schedule
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need a venue for forty-two attendees this Friday, from two to five in the afternoon. The room must be wheelchair accessible and support hybrid video meetings. Our maximum budget is six hundred eighty dollars. Man: Cedar is within budget, but it doesn't support hybrid meetings. Summit has everything we need except the price: it's six hundred ninety dollars. Garden isn't available until three. Woman: Then Harbor is our best choice. Please place a hold on it until Wednesday at four, when the client expects to confirm the attendance list.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Shuttle Service Changes
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, passengers using Route Eight to the Convention Center. On Wednesday only, construction will change the usual departure from eight twenty at Platform Three to eight thirty-five at Platform Five. Route Eight will not stop at Riverside Station that day. Passengers going to Riverside should instead take Route Twelve from Platform Two at eight twenty-five. Monthly passes will be accepted on either route. Please note that some printed signs may still display the old platform number.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Conference Travel Reimbursement and Rescheduled Dates
sections.markdown:
限時：**10 分 0 秒**。

### Employee Conference Expense Policy

> For approved business conferences, the company reimburses hotel charges up to $145 per night for the actual nights stayed. Meal expenses are reimbursed up to $48 per travel day, based on itemized receipts; amounts above the daily limit are not reimbursed. Conference registration is reimbursable at the amount actually paid. Registration booked by May 8 qualifies for the $270 early-bird rate; later registration costs $320. Airport shuttle expenses are reimbursable up to $35 for the entire round trip. Parking expenses are not reimbursable. A claim must be submitted within 10 calendar days after the last day of actual travel. An itemized receipt is required for any single expense exceeding $25.

用途：參考文件

### Avery's Booking and Receipts

> Avery's conference was initially scheduled for June 12–14. Registration was purchased on May 7 for $270. A hotel reservation for two nights costs $138 per night. The actual meal receipts for the three travel days are $40, $52, and $45 respectively. The round-trip airport shuttle receipt is $32. Avery also paid $18 for parking. All reimbursable expenses above $25 have itemized receipts.

用途：參考文件

### Organizer and HR Update

> The organizer has moved the conference to June 19–21. The hotel has transferred Avery's two-night reservation to the new dates at the same $138 nightly rate, with no additional fee. The early-bird registration payment remains valid. HR confirms that the expense-claim deadline is now calculated from the actual final travel day, June 21, making July 1 the final submission date. The parking exclusion remains in force. Avery submitted the claim on June 30.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑨ Day 41 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 38、Day 39、Day 40**。

### 複習重點
- **倒裝與要求式假設語氣**：各寫出 Not until + did 與 request that + be 的例句。
- **時間與政策更新**：區分 originally / now / instead / remains valid。
- **跨文件費用計算**：先判定逐項上限、折扣適用項目及不可報銷費用，再加總。
- **推論與下一步**：區分已確認、尚待確認與被要求採取的行動。

### 錯題標籤
- `G`：一般文法
- `REL`：關係子句
- `COMP`：比較級
- `TIME`：時間子句或期限
- `VOC`：字彙搭配
- `L`：聽力細節
- `DETAIL`：關鍵細節
- `IMP`：隱含意圖
- `I`：資訊整合
- `U`：更新資訊
- `E`：例外規則
- `CAL`：計算
- `BUD`：預算限制
- `CAP`：報銷上限

questions.prompt: Why was the demonstration moved to a later time?

options.B: A client's engineer has a delayed flight.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply about the revised agenda?

options.B: It should not be sent as final yet.
options.D: It has been approved by the engineer.

questions.explanation: 女方要求等待工程師本人確認抵達時間，現有資訊只是航空公司更新，不能當成已定案。

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to do?

options.C: Extend the testing-room booking until 1 P.M.
options.D: Contact the airline for a refund.

questions.explanation: 她請男方將測試室預約由中午延長至下午 1 點。

questions.prompt: Why is Cedar unsuitable?

questions.prompt: Why is Summit unsuitable?

questions.prompt: Until when should the selected room be held?
questions.explanation: 要求保留到星期三下午 4 點，等待客戶確認名冊。

questions.prompt: When will Route Eight depart on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 週三 Route Eight 改為 8:35，8:20 是原時間。

questions.prompt: Which platform will Route Eight use on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 週三改用第五月台；第三月台是舊資訊。

options.B: Take Route Twelve from Platform Two.
options.C: Wait for a later Route Eight bus.

quizzes.title: Conference Travel Reimbursement and Rescheduled Dates

questions.prompt: How much did Avery pay for conference registration?
questions.explanation: Avery 5 月 7 日購買，符合 5 月 8 日前早鳥價 $270；更新公告確認仍有效。

questions.prompt: How much of the hotel charge is reimbursable?
How much of the meal expense is reimbursable?
How much can Avery claim for the airport shuttle?
questions.explanation: 接駁實際費用 $32，未超過往返 $35 上限，故可報銷 $32。

questions.prompt: What is the total reimbursable amount?
Which expense is excluded from reimbursement?
questions.explanation: 政策明定停車費不得報銷，HR 更新也未改變此項。

questions.prompt: What is the final deadline for Avery's claim?
questions.explanation: 6 月 21 日為實際旅行最後一天，HR 明確確認最後提交日是 7 月 1 日。

questions.prompt: What can be concluded about Avery's June 30 submission?

options.B: It missed the deadline by one day.
options.C: It is invalid because the event was rescheduled.
options.D: It must exclude the hotel charges.

questions.explanation: 6 月 30 日在 7 月 1 日截止日之前，提交準時。

questions.prompt: The invoices _____ by Friday will be processed next week.
questions.explanation: 發票是被收到，使用過去分詞 received，等同 that are received。

questions.prompt: Participants _____ arrive after 9 A.M. must check in at the reception desk.
questions.explanation: Participants 指人，且在子句中作主詞，使用 who。

questions.prompt: The keynote session ended slightly _____ than expected.
questions.explanation: than 表示比較，使用 earlier。

questions.prompt: Neither the travel manager nor the assistants _____ available yesterday.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近一致，assistants 為複數，且 yesterday 要用 were。

questions.prompt: The coordinator asked whether the revised itinerary _____ by the director the previous day.
questions.explanation: 比 asked 更早的核准動作使用過去完成被動 had been approved。

questions.prompt: _____ the registration fee includes lunch, it does not cover parking.
questions.explanation: 後面接完整子句，使用 Although；其餘選項後通常接名詞片語。

questions.prompt: Please submit all itemized receipts _____ five business days of returning.
questions.explanation: within five business days of returning 表示返回後五個工作天內。

questions.prompt: The new conference hall can _____ up to 150 guests.
questions.explanation: can 後接原形動詞 accommodate。

questions.prompt: The reimbursement form must be completed _____ before payroll closes.
questions.explanation: 修飾 completed 的方式要用副詞 accurately。

questions.prompt: The manager is responsible _____ verifying travel receipts.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be responsible for + V-ing。

questions.prompt: Employees are encouraged to book flights as _____ as possible.
questions.explanation: as...as 中間使用原級 early。

questions.prompt: The policy applies only to expenses _____ during approved business travel.
questions.explanation: 費用是被產生，使用過去分詞 incurred 修飾 expenses。

questions.prompt: The workshop was postponed _____ a shortage of instructors.
questions.explanation: a shortage of instructors 為名詞片語，使用 due to。

questions.prompt: The schedule was revised to make the check-in process more _____.
questions.explanation: make + 受詞 + 形容詞，選 efficient。

questions.prompt: We will issue the booking confirmation as soon as the deposit _____.
questions.explanation: as soon as 引導未來時間子句，使用現在式 arrives。

questions.prompt: Which phrase best completes blank [1]?

options.A: This procedure is designed to reduce congestion outside the upstairs classrooms.
options.B: The building will be closed to all visitors next Monday.
options.C: Visitors will no longer need to register for training.
options.D: The training sessions have all been canceled.

questions.explanation: This procedure 指前句一樓報到的新規定；接著說明其目的為避免樓上教室外擁擠。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [2]?

options.A: Visitors without a QR code may instead present their registration details at reception.
options.B: All employees must submit expense claims by Friday.
options.C: The cafeteria menu changes every month.
options.D: Visitors must cancel their reservations immediately.

questions.explanation: 前句介紹 QR code，後句補充沒有 QR code 的替代報到方式最連貫。

questions.prompt: Which option best completes blank [3]?
questions.explanation: badge 是被核發，使用未來被動 will be issued。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [4]?

options.A: This will allow the reception team to reuse them for future events.
options.B: The next speaker has published three books.
options.C: Parking fees are included in all room rentals.
options.D: The visitor website was redesigned last year.

questions.explanation: This 指前句歸還識別證的動作，them 指 badges，因而可重複使用。

questions.prompt: The coordinator, _____ oversees registration, will greet the speakers.
questions.explanation: coordinator 指人且關係代名詞作主詞，選 who。

questions.prompt: This year's seminar attracted _____ attendees than last year's.
questions.explanation: than 表示比較，可數複數 attendees 使用 more。

questions.prompt: The refund will be processed once the Finance team _____ the request.
questions.explanation: once 引導未來時間子句，使用現在式 approves。

questions.prompt: Receipts must be uploaded _____ seven days of the trip's end.
questions.explanation: within seven days of... 表示在期限內。

questions.prompt: How many badges can be ready by Tuesday?
questions.explanation: 週二前可準備 18 張，16 張是活動需求。

questions.prompt: What is implied about Tuesday's orientation?

options.B: The first batch of badges is sufficient.
options.D: It will be moved to Wednesday.

questions.explanation: 18 張已大於需求 16 張，活動可照常進行。

questions.prompt: Where should most visitors park starting Thursday?
questions.explanation: 一般訪客自週四起應停 Lot D。

questions.prompt: Who may continue using Garage A?
questions.explanation: 持有無障礙停車許可的員工可繼續停 Garage A。

questions.prompt: What is the total cost for the six workshop registrations and kits?
How much of the department's budget remains?
How much of Rina's taxi fare is reimbursable?
questions.explanation: 車資實付 $34，但上限 $30，故報銷 $30。

questions.prompt: Which cost is not reimbursable?

options.A: The first $25 of the taxi fare
options.B: The taxi fare up to the limit
options.D: The first $30 of the taxi fare

questions.explanation: 政策明確排除小費，故 $5 tip 不可報銷。
